# Form components (form-commons)

<!-- module-flows:start (generated by .claude/bin/module-index; do not edit) -->

Flows: [`content-editing`](../../flows/content-editing/FLOW.md), [`media`](../../flows/media/FLOW.md), [`sign-in`](../../flows/sign-in/FLOW.md).

<!-- module-flows:end -->

## Purpose

Form-bound inputs and list helpers shared by the apps: every input wires itself to react-hook-form with label, description and error; plus the media input with preview and details, the Tiptap richtext input with its toolbar, the sortable sheet, bulk action bar and table pagination.

## Techniques

`FieldWiring.setup.ts` gives ids, registration and the required form context to every input. Texts come in through `*Labels` props (the package holds no app copy). Richtext: Tiptap extensions in `Richtext.setup.ts` (CSP nonce for its styles, palette colours, HTML normalizing); toolbar built from data (`buildRichtextToolbar`). One folder per component with an `index.ts`.

## Technologies

React 19, react-hook-form, Tiptap 3 (starter kit, image, text align, text style; pinned 3.32.0), Radix UI, Tailwind v4, `lucide-react`.

## Entry points

Exported through the package `index.ts` (public API snapshot); used by cms-admin and apps/web.

## Where to change what

A new input: a folder `<name>-input/` with the component and `index.ts`, use `useRegisteredField`/`useFieldIds`, take texts as `labels` props, export it from the package `index.ts`, update the public API snapshot.
